name.value: Harrison Hot Springs Visitor Centre & Sasquatch Museum

description.value: Tourism Harrison Hot Springs is the official visitor information office for the Harrison River Valley, a region encompassing Harrison Hot Springs, Agassiz, Harrison Mills, and surrounding communities. The office serves as a gateway for exploring the area's mix of outdoor adventure, hot springs, agricultural landscapes, and Indigenous cultural heritage. Touring cyclists passing through can expect access to regional maps, itineraries, trails and routes information, and accessibility resources.
